title: tc-dumbbell-chart
description:
Two values per item – before and after, target and actual – as dots joined by a bar, the item that moved most
emphasised, with the end values written beside and a table view.

label.description: The item's name field; by default "label"

start.description: The first value's field (before, target); by default "start"

end.description: The second value's field (after, actual); by default "end"

startLabel.description: The first value's name in the legend and tooltip

endLabel.description: The second value's name in the legend and tooltip

changeLabel.description: The name of the difference in the tooltip

sort.description: Orders the rows by the second value, largest first; sort="false" keeps the data's order

heading.description: The heading, and the chart's name

highlight.description: What to emphasise: an index, a label, a list of them, "max", "min", "first", "last", "none", or a test

format.description: How values are written: "number", "integer", "percent", "compact", "currency", Intl options, or a function

unit.description: The unit after each value: "%", "ms", " runs"

locale.description: The language for numbers and dates, e.g. "de"; by default the browser's

height.description: The plot's height in px; by default the chart's own for its width

still.description: Draws everything at once: no entrance and no transitions

duration.description: How long a move takes, in ms; by default the chart's own

hideLabels.description: Leaves the values off the marks

hideTooltip.description: No tooltip on hover or focus

bare.description: No card: just the plot, for a chart inside another component

view.description: The chart or the same numbers as a table. Changed by the Table button unless a tc-view-change listener calls preventDefault()

labels.description: The words it shows and says, merged over defaultChartLabels

FormatName.description: Number and date formats, through Intl; the default locale is en-US
